check: Action Atlas in-app action browser (app-UI adapter) on a physical iPhone, run by the owner; the App Intent adapter was not exercised
limitations: Owner-performed manual run, with no screen recording.

Corroborated by the receipts in a read-only copy of the device's store. The copy holds text the owner typed, so it is kept private and never committed; this record carries only aggregates and file hashes.
Find Lab Items, Get Lab Item, and Export Lab Item leave no receipt: their results are owner-reported only.

The App Intent adapter was not exercised on the device: the store holds no app-intent receipt. Shortcuts and Siri on the device are not-run, so this record proves the in-app path only and the experiment stays implemented.
Provenance was read from the Info.plist of the e4fe012 iPhone build the integrator installed; the bundle on the device was not read back. The profile expiry comes from that build's embedded profile.

outcome.detail: The owner reports that every in-app action button worked. The device's store corroborates the changes: 6 receipts, all committed and all through the app-ui adapter, for Reset Demo (the first-run seed), Create Collection, Create Item, Update Item, Archive Item, and Restore Item; 5 of them offer an undo. The store holds 3 demo collections and 12 demo items, and 1 collection and 1 item of the person's own. Find, Get, and Export are reads that leave no receipt, so they are owner-reported only.

steps: The integrator installed build e4fe012 (Debug, CoreLocal) on the iPhone with Personal Team signing.
The owner opened the Actions tab and ran the in-app actions from the action browser.
The integrator copied the app's store read-only: xcrun devicectl device copy from --domain-type appDataContainer. The copy stays private.
The copy's receipts and namespace counts were read as aggregates only.
subject: LAB-001
